name: Kaleidoscope
css:
.loader { --accent: var(--loader-color); --accent-2: var(--loader-secondary-color); width: var(--loader-size); height: var(--loader-size); background: repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg, var(--accent) 0deg 30deg, var(--accent-2) 30deg 60deg); clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 63% 38%, 100% 38%, 69% 59%, 82% 100%, 50% 75%, 18% 100%, 31% 59%, 0% 38%, 37% 38%); animation: kaleido calc(var(--loader-speed) * 4) linear infinite; }
@keyframes kaleido { 0% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); } 50% { transform: rotate(180deg) scale(.82); } 100% { transform: rotate(360deg) scale(1); } }
